reproduction: Unlock the Mac normally. Do not alter privacy permissions or system settings. Verify only task-created windows are targeted.
Use the fixture native green button. Require AppKit full-screen entry, AX false-to-true and a unique PID/window-ID mapping; successful subscriptions or matching display bounds are insufficient.
Switch to a different Space using only another task-owned fixture. Do not query or reactivate the capture fixture via Computer Use while it is meant to remain inactive.
Require a Space-away event, targetIsFrontmost=false, retained full-screen state and repeated changing-content samples; return, exit full screen, then close the owned fixture.

Repeat with separate task-created Safari, Chrome and Electron windows and two simultaneous fullscreen fixtures. Observe Stage Manager only if already enabled. Record unknown/ambiguous identities rather than guessing.
No Workspace, virtual display, Frame SSH or running-companion changes during the Mac spike. Keep builds and TMPDIR under this worktree. Do not overwrite any installed binary.

After the Mac gate passes and FW07 is implemented, integrator verifies device placement, focus/input, exit/close cleanup, rapid toggles, manual close, Workspace start/stop/reconnect, inactive no-op and FRAME_WORKSPACE_AUTODETACH=0.
